title: Don't miss it if you like Baroque art.
text: The best thing about the visit is Alberto's explanations. He showed us the most important paintings from the impressive collection of Seville baroque and conveyed his passion for art and history.

title: Visit fine art museum Seville, with Alberto, great guide
text: Great experience with Alberto who made us a guide. Passion in his explanation, and much knowledge about art, empathy, sympathetic and positive. We will repeat with Alberto!!

title: Excellent time at the Seville Museum of Fine Arts
